value.name: Asha avoids confronting Claire
value.description: Asha deliberately keeps her attention away from Claire because she is not ready to reveal what she is holding back.
evidence: looking at Claire now would ask Claire to hold something Asha was not ready to put down yet

value.name: Rosa sends transfer-log instruction
value.description: Asha receives a second message from Rosa telling her to ask Admissions for the transfer log to psychiatric units and to use the term psychiatric.
evidence: Rosa, second message, shorter than the first. Ask Admissions for the transfer log to psychiatric units; they won't volunteer it unless you use the term.

value.name: Asha infers hidden history
value.description: Asha realizes Rosa's message implies Claire has a concealed history involving psychiatric care and that the closet and wallet were not the first signs.
evidence: Asha read it once and understood what Rosa was telling her without saying—that there was a history here she had not been let into, that the closet and the wallet were not the first time, that the word psychiatric was the one Claire had been walking around for three nights

value.name: Hospital denies Marcus Devereaux
value.description: The hospital clerk reports that Marcus Devereaux is not in their system since Thursday.
evidence: when the clerk came back on the line to say no Marcus Devereaux in their system since Thursday

value.name: Asha requests psychiatric transfer log
value.description: Asha calmly asks the clerk to check the transfer log for the psychiatric units after hearing Marcus is not in the system.
evidence: Asha asked, in the same even voice, whether they could check the transfer log for the psychiatric units as well.

value.name: Asha waits on hold and listens for movement upstairs
value.description: While the hospital line cycles hold music, Asha keeps listening for signs of movement from the stairwell and upstairs children.
evidence: The hold music on the hospital line cycled through its second loop while Asha kept the phone to her ear and let her eyes track up the stairwell to the landing, listening for the give of a floorboard or the small cough one of the children sometimes made before waking.

value.name: Claire sits silently counting
value.description: Claire remains seated but clasps her hands in a way that suggests she is counting breaths, minutes, or the distance between rooms.
evidence: Claire had not moved from the chair, but her hands had come together in her lap in a way that meant she was counting something, breaths or minutes or the distance between this kitchen and the one upstairs.

value.name: Rosa sends detox-center lead
value.description: Asha receives another message from Rosa instructing her to check the detox center's admissions.
evidence: The screen against Asha's jaw buzzed once with another message from Rosa, and when Asha tilted the phone enough to read it without taking it from her ear, the words sat plain on the glass: check the detox center's admi
